apps.name: OpenGothic MetalFX Spatial
apps.subtitle: Recommended iOS performance build
apps.localizedDescription: OpenGothic for iPhone and iPad with MetalFX Spatial and automatic Lanczos fallback, 512 x 512 mobile shadow maps, off-screen NPC animation optimization, independent multitouch controls and physical-controller support. Requires legally owned Gothic II: Night of the Raven game data; no game assets are included.
apps.versionDescription: Fixes simultaneous on-screen controls and reduces right-stick touch sensitivity by 15%. MetalFX Spatial remains enabled and MetalFX Temporal remains disabled.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes simultaneous on-screen controls and reduces right-stick touch sensitivity by 15%. MetalFX Spatial remains enabled and MetalFX Temporal remains disabled.
MetalFX Spatial is enabled; MetalFX Temporal is disabled. Includes the maintained iOS performance profile and complete touch controls.
